pages.title: Topology Optimisation
pages.text: $(thing)Topology Optimisation$()$(br2)Let the mathematics decide where material goes: fill a cell only if it carries load. Structures come out like bone. Unlocks a cheaper Metamaterial Sheet.

$(thing)Insight$(): 100$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Optimisation, Metamaterials.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Optimised Pathway.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Each cell of a design holds a share r of material. Write its stiffness Y, from the solid's E and the empty cell's m, with the share raised to a power p, so half-filled cells are not worth keeping.
